items.contentSnippet:
I got tired of all the ugly "free" audio conversion tools littered with ads so I built my own that runs entirely on your machine in the browser.

items.title: Show HN: A CLI with better autocomplete and bookmarks
items.contentSnippet:
This is a shell wrapper for Linux and Windows. It simplifies CLI workflows I find limiting in their default ones. Broadly, it has good autocomplete. It is aware of what directories you have been using, which commands you used recently, and which of these you used in the current directory.
I can type `cd a_few_chars` of a directory I've been do before, or is bookmarked, or is a sub-dir of one I've bookmarked etc, and it gets it right.
It also has a small amount of integration with git and Python

items.title: Show HN: Focusgrid– keyboard-controlled webapps like tmux
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN,
Whenever I use web software I usually wish they put more thought into keyboard user's experience.
So i made Focusgrid! It's a library (vanilla web, with optional react bindings) that lets you build web software with resizable, splittable panes and reprogrammable shortcuts, just like tmux. Would love to see what you build with it. I think email clients, browsers, and various creative tools could all benefit from pane layouts like this.
NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@andrewcyuan/focusg
